# Getting support

RaceControl is a community project, and support happens in the open.

- **Read the docs first:** [docs.getracecontrol.com](https://docs.getracecontrol.com),
  especially [Troubleshooting](https://docs.getracecontrol.com/help/troubleshooting) and
  [Common Questions](https://docs.getracecontrol.com/help/faq).
- **Questions and ideas:** [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Race-Control-HQ/Race-Control/discussions).
- **Bugs and feature requests:** [open an issue](https://github.com/Race-Control-HQ/Race-Control/issues/new/choose)
  using the matching form.
- **Security vulnerabilities:** report privately, as described in the
  [security policy](https://github.com/Race-Control-HQ/Race-Control/security/policy).
  Please do not open a public issue.
